update_interval.description: Delay between updates in tenths of seconds (e.g., 10 for 1 second).

color_enabled.description: Enable color output in the interface.

encode_hide_timer.description: Seconds of inactivity before encoder/decoder meters hide. Use -1 to always show.

reverse_abs.description: Reverse the plot data order to show recent data first.

chart_metric.description: Metric to display in the chart plot (e.g., 'utilization', 'memory').

sort_field.description: Field to use for sorting the process list (e.g., 'pid', 'name', 'memory').

process_metric.description: Metric to display in the process list (e.g., 'memory', 'name').
